caption: The video captures a wide, stationary view of a large waterfall gorge beneath a cloudy sky broken by patches of blue. A tall, dense column of white spray rises through the left and center of the frame, largely obscuring the cliff face behind it. This mist churns continuously, its internal density, dark patches, and soft edges fluctuating while the column holds its vertical position. On the right, a broad sheet of water cascades over the cliff edge, with tan-brown tinted water visible along the top rim. The falling water shows ongoing flow, as white foam streaks and surface textures shift and the rim water moves steadily downward. Foreground branches and leaves frame the top edge and bottom-right corner, and a thin branch arcs in from the left, all remaining fixed. The horizon and right cliff edge stay constant, so the motion comes from the water and mist, not the camera. The sequence reads as one continuous shot of an already active process.
